statement: A preregistered open-loop randomized blocked-pair capacity protocol emits claim-eligible live evidence only after one-use externally observed authorization, consumes distinct coordinate- and row-count-bound PostgreSQL occurrences, and replays its canonical byte-bound artifacts offline after infrastructure cleanup while preserving the complete C3 statistical and non-success contract.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until benchmark-semantic-parity is terminal for the workload surface under test.

Seal randomized blocked pairs, minimum and maximum N, stopping rule, estimator, confidence interval, practical significance, p99 sample minimum, timeout and reject handling, warmup, cache policy, run order, and multiple-comparison treatment before measurement.
Capacity is maximum correct throughput satisfying the shared end-to-end latency and error SLO under open-loop offered load including client queueing.
Apply the harness-fidelity attack checklist and record immutable raw artifacts plus live engagement evidence; a synthetic fixture alone cannot establish measured capacity.
